x-provenance.why_this_file_exists: The excerpt of production-rag's OpenAPI document that agentic-rag-research actually depends on, frozen at the release it was written against. It is the offline half of the compatibility check: tests/contracts runs verify_contract() against this file with no service running, and the opt-in integration run does the same against the live /openapi.json of the instance it is about to query. One verifier, two inputs, so 'compatible' means the same thing offline and live.
x-provenance.generated_by: python -c "from production_rag.main import create_app; from production_rag.config import Settings; print(create_app(Settings()).openapi())" at the tag above, reduced to POST /v1/query and the schemas it references
not_captured: the 422 body schema — the status is the contract fact, the body is not read
QueryRequest.debug and QueryResponse.debug beyond the $ref — diagnostics this client does not ask for

refusal_reasons.note: refusal_reason is declared as a plain string, so the closed set is source-derived, not schema-derived.

citation_order.value: order of first mention in the answer; markers are never renumbered
citation_order.note: This is why the adapter sorts by rank before applying top_k.

unset_fields_are_omitted.note: citations and refusal_reason can be absent from a valid 200 body.

correlation_id.value: X-Request-ID, matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}$, echoed on the response
correlation_id.note: A malformed inbound id is silently replaced upstream, so it is validated here.

no_top_k_control.value: QueryRequest publishes no top_k; the pipeline's top_k is server configuration

QueryRequest.title: QueryRequest
QueryRequest.description:
One grounded-answer request.

Unknown fields are rejected so a misspelled control never silently falls
back to a default. Whitespace-only questions are rejected by Pydantic after
global string stripping, before the query pipeline or a provider is called.

refused.description: Whether the evidence guardrail declined to answer.

refusal_reason.description: Machine-readable refusal explanation; null for grounded answers.

debug.description: Safe pipeline diagnostics, populated only when the request opts in.

QueryDebug.title: QueryDebug
QueryDebug.description:
Safe, opt-in diagnostics for one query execution.

This is deliberately an allowlist rather than a dump of graph state. Provider
credentials, prompts, retrieved passages and model input never belong here.
